results.question: Which towns in Swabia are regional centres (Oberzentren)?
results.answer:
The regional centres (Oberzentren) in Swabia are:

- Dillingen a.d.Donau/Lauingen (Donau)
- Donauwörth
- Günzburg/Leipheim
- Kaufbeuren
- Kempten (Allgäu)
- Lindau (Bodensee) (/Bregenz)
- Memmingen
- (Ulm/)Neu-Ulm
- Nördlingen
- Sonthofen/Immenstadt i.Allgäu

The sources are the Bavarian state development plan (LEP Bayern 2013) and its annex of central places from 2018 [LEP_Anhang_1_Zentrale_Orte_2018.pdf, p. 3–4](LEP_Anhang_1_Zentrale_Orte_2018.pdf, p. 3–4).

results.question: Is Munich an Oberzentrum according to the Bavarian plan?
results.answer: Munich is not listed as a Mittelzentrum (central place) in the Bavarian development plan, but it is mentioned as part of the European Metropolitan Region of Munich (LEP_Bayern_2013.pdf, p. 21). This region is important for innovation and growth in Bavaria due to its national and international functions, high population and economic power, and special significance for economic, traffic, scientific, cultural, and tourist development (LEP_Bayern_2013.pdf, p. 21).
